recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-14963. Revisit only if FHIR-55284 or a successor issue reaches an applied/published decision about moving or changing Account terminology; that later unresolved terminology question should not be treated as an incomplete application of FHIR-14963.
issue_request: FHIR-14963 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for Account, raised in STU3 and applied for R5, asking to add a separate lifecycle/billing status because Account.status only describes whether the account record is usable. The approved resolution added Account.billingStatus 0..1 CodeableConcept with an example AccountBillingStatus binding and a definition explaining how allocated transactions are treated through the billing process.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by d56dbee6b4dd99da6c7f15dcb5eddede7e338445, which added Account.billingStatus to source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml and created source/account/codesystem-account-billing-status.xml plus source/account/valueset-account-billing-status.xml. The follow-up b21787b0158691d646d8be36f39be938ef8d8ccb lower-cased the example CodeSystem codes. Account is active in source/fhir.ini, so these files are in current build scope.
additional_context: FHIR-20496 is a duplicate/same-change-family request for an Account business status and does not need a separate reconciliation commit. PA May 2021 minutes and a terminology Zulip thread show the WG/editor process discussion for applying the FHIR-14963 example binding and support keeping the new low-maturity example terminology in FHIR space at that time. Later FHIR-55284 and TSMG discussion raise an unresolved THO-migration question for several Account terminology artifacts, including account-billing-status, but that Triaged issue is not a final decision and does not supersede FHIR-14963.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml contains Account.billingStatus as 0..1 CodeableConcept with the approved lifecycle/billing-process definition and example AccountBillingStatus binding, and source/account contains the corresponding CodeSystem and ValueSet with the requested example concepts.
